# Welcome people to your space

Use the owner’s chosen space name and check it appears in the Sim. Read [placement guidance](references/placement.md) when choosing a screen. Explain how to reopen the Sim if no display is connected yet.

# Place the welcome display

Choose a location visible to arriving guests. Check the text at the distance people will read it and keep the screen clear of walkways. A browser display is enough to try the kit before adding hardware.
